profilerFormSection.cronDescription: When the profiler runs, as a cron expression, e.g. 0 3 * * * for 03:00 daily.
profilerFormSection.sampleDescription: Cells are rows × profiled columns. A table with more cells than this is profiled from a sample of about this many cells, so a wide table samples fewer rows. Leave empty to profile every row.
profilerFormSection.lowCardinalityDescription: A column with no more distinct values than this has every value counted, and may be inferred a category.
profilerFormSection.driftSeasonDescription: Which earlier runs a run is measured against: every run, or only those at the same point in the day, week or month (UTC).
profilerFormSection.driftSeason_monthly: Monthly — same day of the month
profilerFormSection.driftWindowDescription: How many earlier successful runs at the same point in the season form the baseline. No drift is measured until a table has run this many times.
profilerFormSection.driftDistanceDescription: A measure further from the window's median than this many median absolute deviations is drifting.
profilerFormSection.driftSlopeDescription: A measure whose trend changes it by more than this many median absolute deviations across the window is drifting.
profilerFormSection.driftKsDescription: A distribution whose Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistic against the window's pooled distribution exceeds this is drifting.
profilerFormSection.driftPsiDescription: A distribution whose population stability index against the window's pooled distribution exceeds this is drifting.
profilerFormSection.correlationMaxDescription: How many numeric columns, the table's and its parent tables', enter the correlation matrix and the dependency network.
profilerFormSection.jointMaxDistinctDescription: A text column with no more distinct values than this enters the correlations and joint counts as a category.
profilerFormSection.categoryMaxDescription: How many category columns enter the correlations and joint counts; those holding a value in the most rows are kept.
